name: threads-video-studio
description: Make short vertical AI videos for Threads (anime/illustration style, Japanese narration, captions, BGM, call-to-action), with human approval gates, frame-level QA, and scheduled auto-posting and review. Uses fal.ai, ElevenLabs and the Threads API.

fal_key.title: fal.ai API key
fal_key.description: Used for image, video and music generation. Get it at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Used for Japanese narration (eleven_v3) and BGM. Get it at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys

threads_access_token.title: Threads access token
threads_access_token.description: Long-lived Threads API token for scheduled posting and insights. Leave empty if you only make videos.

narrator_voice_id.title: Default narrator voice id
narrator_voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice id used when a project does not specify one. Choose a native Japanese library voice.

cta_url.title: Call-to-action link
cta_url.description: Link placed in each post, e.g. your LINE official account URL. A per-post tag (?t=<slug>) is added automatically.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Where video projects, the posting queue and reports are stored. Default: ~/threads-videos

media_bucket.title: S3 bucket for posting videos (optional)
media_bucket.description: Private bucket used to hand videos to the Threads API through 1-hour signed URLs. Objects expire after 1 day.

aws_profile.title: AWS CLI profile (optional)
aws_profile.description: Profile used with the bucket above.

aws_region.title: AWS region (optional)
aws_region.description: Region of the bucket above, e.g. ap-northeast-1.
